"Create a pixel-art idle/clicker game in a single HTML file (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Theme: A mystical purple temple. 

CORE GAMEPLAY:
- Click the central temple to earn \"Essence\".
- Shop system with 25 unique upgrades. 
- HARD PROGRESSION: Upgrade costs must scale aggressively (e.g., cost * 1.15 to 1.25 per level). The game should take hours to progress, not minutes.
- Idle income: Some upgrades generate Essence per second (EPS).
- Number formatting: Show numbers like 1.2K, 3.4M, 1.5B.

VISUAL PROGRESSION (Crucial):
- The temple starts empty and basic.
- Every upgrade purchased must visually change the temple. Add pixel-art elements on top of the base temple. 
- List of visual details to unlock across the 25 upgrades: Levers on the wall, glowing runes, extra pillars, floating crystals, wall torches, hanging banners, a central statue, an extra floor, an orb, vines, a portal, stained glass, stone gargoyles, magical sparks, and a glowing roof. 
- Each shop item must be tied to a specific visual element.

WEAK PRESTIGE SYSTEM (Rebirth):
- Unlocked only after earning 1,000,000 total Essence.
- Resets Essence and all 25 upgrades (temple becomes empty again).
- Grants \"Divine Sparks\". Formula: total_essence_earned / 1,000,000 (round down).
- Each Divine Spark gives a +5% permanent multiplier to all Essence earned (click and passive). 
- Keep it weak so the game lasts long. Prestige should feel like a slow, steady boost.

UI @COMMENT_BODY@ DESIGN:
- Purple color palette (violet, lavender, deep plum, magenta).
- Pixel-art style (use CSS image-rendering: pixelated, blocky shapes).
- Left/Center: The Temple (clickable area).
- Right/Bottom: Scrollable Shop with the 25 upgrades (Name, Cost, Effect).
- Top: Current Essence, Essence per Click, Essence per Second, and Prestige info.

TECH REQUIREMENTS:
- localStorage saving (save Essence, upgrades, and prestige multipliers).
- Mobile-friendly (touch events).
- Write clean, commented code. 
- Make sure the visual elements are arranged nicely around/on the temple so it looks like it's being built up.

Deliver the complete, playable code in one block. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable pixel-art idle/clicker game themed around a mystical purple temple, delivered as a single HTML file.

## Requirements
- Click the central temple to earn Essence; include 25 unique upgrades with aggressively scaling costs and some passive Essence-per-second income.
- Each upgrade must add a distinct visual detail to the temple.
- Rebirth unlocks after 1,000,000 Essence earned, resets Essence and upgrades, and grants `floor(total_essence_earned / 1,000,000)` Divine Sparks; each spark adds 5% permanent Essence gain.
- Purple pixel-art UI; responsive phone/tablet layout; abbreviated large numbers; `localStorage` persistence; touch-friendly controls; clean, commented code.
- User asked for the complete playable code in one block; build the game in the existing project rather than asking questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game as `index.html`, with inline CSS, SVG pixel-art, and JavaScript.
- Added capped 8-hour offline income, optional click sound, confirmation prompts for rebirth and reset, and auto-save.
- Prestige threshold and spark award use lifetime earning within the current age (`state.totalEarned`), reset on rebirth.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with responsive purple UI, basic SVG temple, 25 upgrade definitions and visual details, scalable pricing, click and passive income, number formatting, save/load, offline earnings, and prestige.
- Extracted inline JavaScript to `/tmp/opencode/temple.js`; `node --check /tmp/opencode/temple.js` passed before the latest prestige/accounting edits.
- Captured and inspected a desktop screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/temple.png`.

### Active
- Validate the latest edits and resolve any remaining gameplay defects.
- Respond to the user with a concise completion note and the requested complete playable code in one block, or direct them to the created file if appropriate.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` could not run because its expected Chromium installation is missing (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`); a screenshot was nevertheless captured using system Chromium.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check` against the extracted latest inline script and smoke-test the game in Chromium for console/runtime errors and click/upgrades behavior.
2. Check prestige gain math and confirm UI accurately uses lifetime-in-age earnings; verify saved legacy state handling.
3. Finish with the playable code/file reference, noting any assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: entire game implementation; currently uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/temple.js`: extracted inline JS from before the latest changes; regenerate before validating.
- `/tmp/opencode/temple.png`: desktop screenshot of game UI.

## Important Context
- Current game save key is `violet-temple-save-v1`; code uses `PRESTIGE_AT=1_000_000`, and the 25 upgrades are all present.
- Latest edits introduced `totalEarned` in save/load and switched rebirth checks/award to it; rebirth resets `totalEarned` and `runEarned`.
- Screenshot command used system Chromium; `playwright-cli` requires an unavailable browser installation.

Created the complete single-file game in [`index.html`](index.html). It includes all 25 visually distinct upgrades, passive Essence income, rebirth with permanent Divine Sparks, autosaving, capped offline earnings, and a responsive mobile layout.

I also checked that the page loads without JavaScript errors, all 25 shop items render, clicking earns Essence, and rebirth awards the expected Sparks and resets the temple.
